title: Backup & restore
exportDescription: Bundle follows, watch history, followed areas and settings into one JSON file and save it through the system share sheet.
importDescription: Paste the backup JSON and confirm to overwrite the current data; WebDAV can download and restore too.
importFileNote: Picking a local file arrives with the file picker dependency; paste the content or use WebDAV for now.
importConfirmDesc: Importing clears and rewrites follows, watch history, followed areas and settings. The current data cannot be recovered.
importDone: Restored; restart the app to apply everything
importBadData: This is not a valid backup
webdavAccountsHint: Opening an account makes it the current one and walks its folders; the pencil edits or deletes it.
webdavAccountNameHint: Left blank, the server's host names it
webdavNoAccountsDesc: Add a server before uploading a backup or restoring from one.
webdavAccountDeleteDesc: Removes the saved address and password on this device only; the server's files stay as they are.
webdavDeleteFolderDesc: Deletes the folder and everything inside it on the server.
webdavTestDesc: Checks the address and the password without sending any data.
webdavUploadDesc: Writes this device's data and uploads it to the current account's root, replacing the same-named file.
webdavDownloadDesc: Reads the current account's backup file and overwrites this device with it.
webdavBrowseDesc: Walk the server like a folder: open directories, make one, upload or restore any file.
webdavDescription: The backup lives on the server as {file}: upload overwrites it, download restores it.
webdavConfigDescription: Fill in the WebDAV server address and account; the password is kept in the system's secure storage and never enters a backup.
webdavPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep the stored one
webdavUrlMissing: Fill in the server URL first
webdavDownloadConfirmTitle: Download and overwrite the current data?
webdavDownloadConfirmDesc: The server's {file} will overwrite this device's follows, history, areas and settings.
webdavAuthFailed: Authentication failed; check the username or password
webdavNotFound: No backup file on the server yet
webdavNetworkFailed: Network error; check the URL or the proxy
webdavServerFailed: The server answered with an error ({status})
folderUnwritable: The backup folder is not writable; pick another
folderSaveFailed: Could not save the backup folder
openFolderFailed: Could not open the backup folder
createDescription: Choose what goes into a file in the backup folder: follows, watch history, followed areas, recording tasks and settings.
createFollowsDescription: Backs up followed rooms and areas only.
filesEmpty: No backup files in this folder yet
filesFailed: Could not read the backup folder
filesFailedHint: Check that the folder exists and is readable, then tap to retry.
restoreConfirmDesc: Restoring {name: String} overwrites this device's follows, watch history, followed areas, recording tasks and settings. The current data cannot be recovered.
restoreFollowsConfirmDesc: Restoring {name: String} overwrites this device's follows and followed areas; other data stays as it is.
restoreRecordingsBusy: This device is recording or still finishing a take — end it before restoring the recording tasks
deleteFileFailed: Could not delete the backup file
webdavLoadFailed: The folder could not be read
webdavRestoreDesc: The server file replaces this device’s follows, history, areas, recording tasks and settings.
webdavDeleteDesc: Only that server file is removed; this device keeps its data.
webdavMoveIntoItself: A folder cannot be moved into itself
sectionFollowsDesc: The streamers and rooms you follow, with their tags.
sectionHistoryDesc: The rooms you watched and when.
sectionRecordingsDesc: The recording tasks' setup; a running task restores as waiting.
sectionSettingsDesc: Appearance, playback, danmaku, navigation and the other preferences.
sectionIptvDesc: Playlists, groups, guide sources and channel mappings; the channels and programmes are rebuilt by a refresh.
sectionMultiviewDesc: The multiview layout and the room in each slot.
sectionSecretsDesc: Platform cookies, WebDAV passwords and the like. Written in plain text — only keep it somewhere you trust.
pickRestoreNote: A checked section replaces this device's data; an unchecked one stays as it is.
secretsSwitchTitle: Include account credentials in backups and syncs
secretsSwitchDescription: Off, no backup, upload or LAN sync carries cookies or passwords; on, the section appears when you pick what to include.

webdavHelp.introBody:
Jianguoyun supports WebDAV access for backup and file management. This guide uses a personal Jianguoyun account as an example.
Free plan: 1 GB uploads/month and 3 GB downloads/month. Storage grows with uploaded data. Plans can change; check the official pages before relying on a quota.
webdavHelp.appPasswordHint: Use the dedicated app password, not your account password
webdavHelp.registerSteps:
1. Open https://www.jianguoyun.com in a browser.
2. Select Sign up and register with an email address.
3. Complete account verification when prompted.
webdavHelp.registerForm: Complete the requested account details on the registration page.
webdavHelp.loginSteps:
1. App passwords are managed on the Jianguoyun website.
2. Sign in with your registered account and account password.
webdavHelp.accountSteps: 1. Open the account menu and select Account information.
webdavHelp.generateSteps:
3. Find Third-party app management.
4. Add an app password, give it a recognizable name such as Pure Live, and generate it.
webdavHelp.passwordOnce: 5. Copy the generated password immediately and store it securely. Create a new one if it is lost or revoked.
webdavHelp.genericSection: Enter the configuration in Pure Live
webdavHelp.genericBody:
Name: any label that identifies this configuration
Address: https://dav.jianguoyun.com/dav/ or an existing subdirectory URL
Username: your Jianguoyun account email
Password: the dedicated app password

For another WebDAV provider, use that provider's directory URL and credentials. Pure Live keeps each configuration separate.
webdavHelp.issueCredentialsA: Check the account email and use the dedicated app password. Regenerate the app password if it was revoked.
webdavHelp.issueBrowserQ: 2. The address looks different in a browser
webdavHelp.issueBrowserA: A WebDAV endpoint is intended for a WebDAV client and may show an authentication prompt or an error in a normal browser. Verify it inside Pure Live.
webdavHelp.issueUploadA: Check the account quota, directory write access, available network connection, and whether the remote file still exists.
webdavHelp.issueTimeoutA: Recheck the complete HTTPS directory URL and current network or proxy route, then retry from the inline error action.
webdavHelp.issueRevokeQ: 5. Revoke access or reset a password
webdavHelp.issueRevokeA: Delete the matching entry in Third-party app management, generate a new app password, and update the Pure Live configuration.
webdavHelp.limitsBody: Jianguoyun's official WebDAV help currently lists a default 500 MB upload limit, up to 600 requests per 30 minutes for free accounts (1,500 for paid accounts), and up to 750 entries per directory response. Provider rules can change; consult the official help page for the latest limits.
webdavHelp.summaryBody:
Address: https://dav.jianguoyun.com/dav/
Username: your Jianguoyun account email
Password: the dedicated app password generated by Jianguoyun
